WITH OrderStats AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customerID,
        c.companyName,
        o.orderID,
        o.orderDate,
        (od.unitPrice * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) as lineTotal,
        LAG(o.orderDate) OVER (PARTITION BY c.customerID ORDER BY o.orderDate) as prevOrderDate
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON c.customerID = o.customerID
    JOIN order_details od ON o.orderID = od.orderID
),
CustomerMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        customerID,
        companyName,
        SUM(lineTotal) as totalLifetimeRevenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT orderID) as totalOrders,
        AVG(date_diff('day', prevOrderDate, orderDate)) as avgDaysBetweenOrders,
        MAX(orderDate) as lastOrderDate
    FROM OrderStats
    GROUP BY customerID, companyName
)
SELECT 
    customerID,
    companyName,
    totalLifetimeRevenue,
    totalOrders,
    avgDaysBetweenOrders,
    CASE 
        WHEN date_diff('day', lastOrderDate, CURRENT_DATE) > 180 THEN 'Churned' 
        ELSE 'Active' 
    END as status
FROM CustomerMetrics

    SELECT 
        c.customerID,
        c.companyName,
        SUM(od.unitPrice * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderID) AS total_orders,
        MAX(o.orderDate) AS last_order_date,
        AVG(date_diff('day', prev_order_date, orderDate)) AS avg_days_between_orders
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON c.customerID = o.customerID
    JOIN order_details od ON o.orderID = od.orderID
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT orderID, customerID, orderDate,
               LAG(orderDate) OVER (PARTITION BY customerID ORDER BY orderDate) AS prev_order_date
        FROM orders
    ) o_lag ON o.orderID = o_lag.orderID
    GROUP BY c.customerID, c.companyName
)
SELECT 
    customerID,
    companyName,
    total_revenue,
    total_orders,
    avg_days_between_orders,
    CASE 
        WHEN date_diff('day', last_order_date, (SELECT MAX(orderDate) FROM orders)) > 180 THEN 'Churned' 
        ELSE 'Active' 
    END AS customer_status
FROM OrderStats
